title: Identify two actual width-ten Clifford Gram blocks
body:

| Actual module | Dimension | Multiplicity in V^10 | Gram eigenvalue | Regular block dimension |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sym²V | 36 | 2244 | 176715/32768 | 1296 |
| Λ²V | 28 | 2159 | 874395/131072 | 784 |

These are two specified block contributions. Global spectral endpoints, an exact condition number, total multiplicities if other blocks share an eigenvalue, and a threshold improvement remain unclaimed.

The self-contained written argument uses Bell matrices and distinct Pauli weight lines to prove irreducibility. The explicit all-element phase-cancelling intertwiner is Vbar⊗µ ≅ V⊗Perm(Qorbit). An elementary transvection argument proves two-transitivity. Transvection trace15 distinguishes source row7 from the other degree35 row8 (trace−5); row6 is the unique degree27 constituent. Correct tensor reciprocity gives269+1975 and269+1890. Classical Bell/Pauli/permutation/character methods are credited, not claimed as new general representation theory.
